Gidsel-Rausch und Entscheidung in letzter Sekunde: Berlin gewinnt Krimi in Göppingen

en.title: Füchse Berlin win 32-31 away at Göppingen
en.dek: Berlin wins 32-31 in Göppingen after Champions League loss
facts: Füchse Berlin won 32-31 away against Göppingen on 22 November 2026
The victory came after the team's recent Champions League loss to Aalborg
Kicker reported a decisive moment involving Gidsel in the last second
Die Zeit described the game as a nervous finish (Zittersieg)
Kicker stated the guests showed the appropriate reaction to their previous defeat
body: Füchse Berlin won 32-31 away against Frisch Auf Göppingen on 22 November 2026. The win came after the team's recent Champions League loss to Aalborg, as both Kicker and Die Zeit covered the match.
Kicker reported that the guests showed the appropriate reaction to their previous defeat, while Die Zeit noted the game was a nervous finish for the Berlin side.

pt.title: Füchse Berlin vence fora por 32-31 em Göppingen
pt.dek: Berlim vence por 32-31 em Göppingen após derrota na Liga dos Campeões
facts: Füchse Berlin venceu fora por 32-31 contra Göppingen a 22 de novembro de 2026
A vitória ocorreu após a recente derrota da equipa na Liga dos Campeões contra Aalborg
O Kicker reportou um momento decisivo envolvendo Gidsel no último segundo
Die Zeit descreveu o jogo como um final nervoso (Zittersieg)
O Kicker afirmou que os visitantes demonstraram a reação apropriada à sua derrota anterior
body: O Füchse Berlin venceu fora por 32-31 contra o Frisch Auf Göppingen a 22 de novembro de 2026. A vitória ocorreu após a recente derrota do equipa na Liga dos Campeões para o Aalborg, conforme noticiaram o Kicker e a Die Zeit.
O O Kicker reportou que os visitantes demonstraram a reação adequada à derrota anterior, enquanto a Die Zeit observou que o jogo foi um final nervoso para a equipa de Berlim.

problemsFixed: Fact 'Gidsel made the decisive play in the final seconds' not supported by sources and not attributed to Kicker
Evaluative terms 'Zittersieg' and 'Krimi' used without attribution; style guide bans evaluative framing unless attributed
Repetitive sentence openings with 'Füchse Berlin' and 'The match' at start of sentences
Summary sentence 'The victory provided a domestic win following the European setback' evaluates rather than reports
Context paragraph not supported by provided sources
